text: All the coverage was taken with a low quality camera that’s commonly referred to as “Shitcam”. The car will often be completely blurred, with a **very large blur** covering the back and a [somewhat smaller blur](https://goo.gl/maps/YfaEf11wuzdt3NYv8) covering the front.

NOTE: The coverage is a newer variant of shitcam, where the image is dimmer and hazier than the original shitcam primarily found in [India](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3MYW94icKvwhWTc66) and [Nigeria](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eETqUgMHvyiCR4di8).
text_zh: 所有的街景覆蓋都是用畫質低劣的相機拍攝的，通常被稱為「爛相機」。車輛經常完全模糊，車尾有**非常大的模糊**遮蓋，車頭則有一個[稍小的模糊](https://goo.gl/maps/YfaEf11wuzdt3NYv8)遮蓋。
注意：此街景是爛相機較新的一種變體，影像比主要在[印度](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3MYW94icKvwhWTc66)和[奈及利亞](https://maps.app.goo.gl/eETqUgMHvyiCR4di8)發現的原版爛相機還要更暗且更模糊。

text: **Portuguese** is the main language used on São Tomé and Príncipe.
text_zh: **葡萄牙語**是聖多美和普林西比主要使用的語言。

text: On top of the language, the Portuguese influence can also be seen in infrastructure, such as ladder poles and pedestrian signs with the same design as in Portugal.
text_zh: 除了語言之外，葡萄牙的影響也能在基礎設施中看到，例如與葡萄牙相同設計的階梯電線桿和行人標誌。

text: São Tomé and Príncipe are **tropical islands**, which are almost completely covered in rainforests. Banana plants are especially common throughout the islands.
text_zh: 聖多美和普林西比是**熱帶島嶼**，幾乎完全被雨林覆蓋。香蕉樹在整個島嶼上尤其常見。

text: In many locations, you will notice a **slanted antenna** protruding from the side of the car.
text_zh: 在許多地點，你會注意到一支**傾斜的天線**從車身側邊伸出。

text: Some wooden poles are painted **blue **on the bottom. You can also read the letters **CST **on them.
text_zh: 有些木製電線桿底部漆成**藍色**。你也可以在上面讀到字母**CST**。

text: Taxis and minibuses are painted in a **bright yellow** colour.
text_zh: 計程車和小巴士漆成**鮮黃色**。

text: This desaturated and even dimmer variant of shitcam is most common on Príncipe.
text_zh: 這種去色且更昏暗的爛相機變體在普林西比島上最常見。

text: The car used on Príncipe can be recognised by the **blue** roof and silver roof rails.
NOTE: Remember that it can sometimes be blurred out.
text_zh: 普林西比島上使用的車輛可透過**藍色**車頂和銀色車頂架來辨識。
注意：記住它有時候可能會被模糊處理。

text: The car used on São Tomé is **black** with black roof rails. In most locations, it is blurred out.
text_zh: 聖多美島上使用的車輛是**黑色**的，配有黑色車頂架。在大多數地點，車子都被模糊處理了。

text: You can find **oil palm plantations** in southern São Tomé.
text_zh: 你可以在聖多美南部找到**油棕櫚園**。

text: The town of Trinidade has poles with **red and white** pole paint.
text_zh: 特林達代鎮（Trinidade）的電線桿上有**紅白相間**的塗漆。
